cards.contract: Grupo legacy/tooling/store.py: 1 archivos. Terminales leido PY """Persistent mission journal for the Tool Ecosystem v2.  The store is deliberately independent from the tool registry and contracts. Every public operation opens its own SQLite connection, applies the durability pragmas, and closes it after commit/rollback. Existing databases are never deleted, renamed, or silently rebuilt when validation fails. """
